name: Castaño del Robledo (Spain)
description: Green field within a yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castaño del Robledo (a chestnut tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Castaño del Robledo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
